dedupe_keys.name: turkiye streamflow observation yearbooks dsi and eie akım gozlem yıllıkları

description: The streamflow observation yearbooks (Akım Gözlem Yıllıkları) of Türkiye's General Directorate of State Hydraulic Works (DSİ) publish the observations of the national stream gauging network. The DSİ page offers the DSİ yearbooks from 1959 to 2021 and the yearbooks of the former Electrical Works Survey Administration (EİE), which ran gauges for hydropower planning, from 1935 to 2011, together giving more than eighty years of river flow records across the country's basins. Files are grouped by period and delivered as RAR and ZIP archives, with the 2021 yearbook as a PDF; downloads are free and need no registration, but the page states no licence. Caveats: the newest yearbook is for 2021, the form of the older volumes (scans or tables) is unknown, the station count and the time step of the values could not be confirmed from the provider page, and no archive was downloaded so the layout is unknown. Simulation uses: long flow series for reservoir yield, irrigation and water supply planning, flood frequency and low-flow (drought) analysis, calibration of hydrological models, and hydropower resource studies. Related records: the Spanish Gauging Yearbook (data-spain-anuario-de-aforos-gauging-yearbook).
